notes.title: Wuthering Waves now Steam Deck Playable, and works on Desktop Linux with one tweak
notes.notes:
After Wuthering Waves launched on Steam, it was left broken on all Linux platforms including SteamOS and Steam Deck but now it works.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/07/wuthering-waves-now-steam-deck-playable-and-works-on-desktop-linux-with-one-tweak/

notes.title: Wuthering Waves arrives on Steam, another with anti-cheat problems on Steam Deck and Desktop Linux
notes.notes:
Here we go again. Wuthering Waves has now released on Steam from KURO GAMES and it appears to be having problems on Steam Deck and Desktop Linux due to the anti-cheat being used.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/04/wuthering-waves-arrives-on-steam-another-with-anti-cheat-problems-on-steam-deck-and-desktop-linux/
